description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides basic API endpoints including a welcome message, a redirect to Swagger UI documentation, a health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for the Spring Boot application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info endpoints.
